name: explore-room
title: Explore a room
description: Cover a room from up to six viewpoints with a left/centre/right head sweep both ways; succeeds when at least 75 % of the room's furniture was seen. A piece of furniture counts once one of its support layers (top or shelf) is in view; seeing every shelf of one piece is explore_furniture.
use_when: A room must be surveyed before planning (unknown layout or objects); one glance per piece of furniture.

not_to_be_confused_with.search: search looks for one object and stops when found.
not_to_be_confused_with.explore_furniture: explore_furniture sees every layer of one piece; explore_room counts a piece once one layer is seen.

postconditions.name: room_explored
postconditions.meaning: At least 75 % of the room's furniture was seen (one of its support layers in the head camera).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: room_explored
checks.meaning: At least 75 % of the room's furniture was seen (one of its support layers in the head camera).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

next.when: a specific object must then be located
every shelf of one piece of furniture must be seen
next.reason: room coverage counts a piece once; its other layers may still hide objects

fallback_for.when: the object is not on any visited support
objects of the category may be out of view

failure.on_failure: stop; return the error code and every measured pre- and postcondition; nothing is retried or repaired, the planner chooses what to do.
